Prep data
```{r}
# Create a new column using the first two terms of the sample's name
asv_db <- as.data.frame(t(asv))
asv_db$experience_short_sample_type <- (substr(rownames(asv_db), 1, 4))
asv_db$experience_short_sample_type <- gsub('-', '_', asv_db$experience_short_sample_type)
asv_db <- as.data.frame(asv_db) %>%
dplyr::select(experience_short_sample_type, everything())  # Reorder columns

# Create a new column using for the time of each sample
asv_db$time <- (substr(rownames(asv_db), 6, 8))
asv_db <- as.data.frame(asv_db) %>%
dplyr::select(time, everything())  # Reorder columns

# Create a new column using for the bioreactor of each sample
asv_db$bioreactor <- (substr(rownames(asv_db), 10, 11))
asv_db <- as.data.frame(asv_db) %>%
dplyr::select(bioreactor, everything())  # Reorder columns
```

#Get the shared percentage through time
```{r}
# Filter for relevant sample types
filtered_db <- asv_db %>% 
  filter(experience_short_sample_type %in% c('E1_R', 'E1_W'))

# Group by bioreactor and time
grouped_db <- filtered_db %>%
  group_by(bioreactor, time)

#remove the first day as it doesn't have data for the planktonic community
grouped_db <- subset(grouped_db, time != 'T01')

# Function to calculate unique and shared percentages
calculate_shared_unique_percentages <- function(df) {
  asv_cols <- df %>% select(starts_with("ASV")) %>% colnames()
  
  # Split into E2_R and E2_W
  df_r <- df %>% filter(experience_short_sample_type == 'E1_R')
  df_w <- df %>% filter(experience_short_sample_type == 'E1_W')
  
  # Calculate number of ASVs > 0 for each sample type
  count_r <- colSums(df_r[asv_cols] > 0)
  count_w <- colSums(df_w[asv_cols] > 0)
  
  # Determine shared ASVs
  shared_asvs <- sum(count_r > 0 & count_w > 0)
  
  # Determine ASVs unique to E2_R and E2_W
  unique_r <- sum(count_r > 0 & count_w == 0)
  unique_w <- sum(count_w > 0 & count_r == 0)
  
  # Calculate total unique ASVs (number of ASVs where at least one count is greater than 0)
  total_asvs <- sum(count_r > 0 | count_w > 0)
  
  # Calculate the percentages
  shared_percentage <- (shared_asvs / total_asvs) * 100
  unique_r_percentage <- (unique_r / total_asvs) * 100
  unique_w_percentage <- (unique_w / total_asvs) * 100
  
  return(data.frame(
    shared_percentage = shared_percentage,
    unique_r_percentage = unique_r_percentage,
    unique_w_percentage = unique_w_percentage
  ))
}

# Apply the function to each group and combine the results. Exclude T21 of B1 as amplification didn't work
percentage_results <- grouped_db %>%
  filter(!(bioreactor == 'B1' & time == 'T21')) %>% #to remove T21 of B1 as the amplification didn't work
    summarise(
    results = list(calculate_shared_unique_percentages(cur_data())),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  unnest(cols = c(results)) # Unnest the results data frame to get separate columns

#switch to long df for plotting
long_df <- percentage_results %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(shared_percentage, unique_r_percentage, unique_w_percentage),
    names_to = "asv_type",
    values_to = "percentage"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    asv_type = recode(asv_type,
                      shared_percentage = "Shared",
                      unique_r_percentage = "Sessile",
                      unique_w_percentage = "Planktonic")
  )

```

#draw a graph of the varying shared percentage through time for each bioreactor
```{r}
long_df$time <- gsub('T', '', long_df$time)

plot <- ggplot(long_df, aes(x = time, y = percentage)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = bioreactor, linetype = asv_type, group = interaction(bioreactor, asv_type)), size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Time (days)",
    y = "Proportion of ASVs (%)",
    color = "Bioreactor",
    linetype = "ASV Type"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black")
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Shared" = "solid",
    "Sessile" = "twodash",
    "Planktonic" = "dotted"
  ))



print(plot)

#saving the pdf 
ggsave(filename = "median_shared_asv_percentage_plot_euc.pdf", plot = plot, path = "~/stats/shared_ASV/euc/sessile/", device = "pdf", width = 10, height = 7.5)
```
